sections.title: 1. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect the following information to provide you with a better experience:

items.label: Personal information:
items.text: Name, email address, and other relevant information you provide when registering.

items.label: Usage information:
items.text: Data about how you use the application, such as exchanges completed and search preferences.

items.label: Technical information:
items.text: IP address, device type, operating system, and browsing data.

sections.title: 2. How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the collected information to:
items: Send you relevant updates and notifications about your account or the application.

sections.title: 3. Sharing your information
paragraphs: Your personal information will not be shared with third parties without your consent, except in the following cases:

sections.title: 4. Information security
paragraphs: We are committed to protecting your personal information. We implement reasonable security measures to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure of your information.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. If you wish to exercise these rights, you can contact us through the channels provided at the end of this policy.

sections.title: 6. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of important changes by publishing a new version on this page.

sections.title: 7. Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please contact us:
items: Address: Avda. Reina Mercedes s/n, 41012 Seville

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your actions and preferences (such as login, language, font size, and other settings) for a period of time.

sections.title: 2. What types of cookies do we use?
paragraphs: Our application uses the following types of cookies:

items.label: Essential cookies:
items.text: They are necessary for the basic operation of the application and cannot be disabled.

items.label: Functionality cookies:
items.text: They remember your preferences and improve your user experience.

items.label: Analytics cookies:
items.text: They help us understand how users interact with our application by collecting information anonymously.

sections.title: 3. How can you manage cookies?
paragraphs: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect application functionality.
